patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesloft and ZoomInfo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Salesloft only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, seque” rather than ZoomInfo's shape. Choose ZoomInfo only if your buying job matches “Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enrichment, in” rather than Salesloft's shape. Workflow advantage: Salesloft leans sales-engagement; ZoomInfo leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesloft and ZoomInfo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Salesloft is Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, sequencing, coaching; talk-to-sales pricing.; ZoomInfo is Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enrichment, intent, and Copilot workflows — custom-quote packagi.
- Workflow coverage skew: Salesloft-leaning sales-engagement vs ZoomInfo-leaning data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: Salesloft — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; ZoomInfo — Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote.

Limitations — Salesloft: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — talk-to-sales only; ZoomInfo: Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Credit consumption on export (CSV/CRM/API) requires ongoing governance.

Poor-fit cases: Salesloft is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · ZoomInfo is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote · Avoid Salesloft if you actually need ZoomInfo's motion (Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enri)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
